mergeSort :: [Int] -> [Int]
mergeSort [] = []
mergeSort [x] = [x]
mergeSort xs = merge (mergeSort left) (mergeSort right)
  where
    mid = length xs `div` 2
    left = take mid xs
    right = drop mid xs

merge :: [Int] -> [Int] -> [Int]
merge [] ys = ys
merge xs [] = xs
merge (x:xs) (y:ys)
  | x <= y    = x : merge xs (y:ys)
  | otherwise = y : merge (x:xs) ys
